title: Everyday agent tasks: how often the models got them fully right, and what a run cost
intro: Slide across four of the twelve models ShellBench tested to see the share of 100 everyday tasks each one completed, averaged across five agent tools, and the estimated cost of a single run.
note: All figures are from the OpenClaw Foundation’s ShellBench post of 24 November 2026; the full paper is not yet published. A task counts only if every requirement is met. Pass rates are averaged across five agent harnesses, and costs are the researchers’ estimates from recorded token use at study prices, excluding grading. The repeat-attempt figures were published for GPT-6 Astra only. The models were not tested inside consumer apps such as Muse, Dots or Claude Duet.
